title: Homelyes XIII in Cornysche: John Tregear's Middle Cornish translation of Bonner's Homilies (BL Add MS 46397), text of C. Bice's 1969 edition, multilingual Wikisource
notes:
License: the 16th-century text is public domain; the Wikisource page (pinned revision 772397) is published under Wikisource's terms, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Terms_of_Use); the page states it reproduces Bice's edition as keyed by Keith Syed. The url pins a fixed page revision (oldid), so the bytes do not change. 211,854 bytes; wikitext with an HTML
at every line end (893 of them: the generic normalization turns each into the letters 'br', about 2,700 characters, 1.3%) and a short English introduction and contents list. vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'cornish') gives 202,745 characters. Closest openly licensed period text for the Cornish proposal: a Brittonic language written c. 1555.
